title: Flowspace Fulfillment Grows 90% as FlowspaceAI Expands Across Operations
summary: Flowspace reports 90% growth as FlowspaceAI expands across fulfillment operations, using AI agents to investigate issues, reduce manual work, and support scale.
body_markdown:
**Autonomous agents help brands scale without proportional headcount growth while supporting Flowspace’s expansion**


LOS ANGELES--([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )--Flowspace, the software and operations platform powering modern fulfillment for e-commerce and B2B brands, today announced the continued expansion of FlowspaceAI, its growing suite of[AI agents for logistics operations](https://flow.space/platform/flowspaceai) running in production across core fulfillment workflows. The expansion comes as the business is on track to exceed 90% year-over-year growth.


FlowspaceAI is designed to help brands increase order volume without proportionally expanding their internal operations teams. By monitoring fulfillment activity, identifying risks and resolving routine issues, the technology reduces the manual work and operational complexity traditionally associated with growth.


“The winner in this category won’t be whoever ships the shiniest AI features. It will be whoever gets the most operational leverage from the technology and can pass on those savings to brands. That is the business we have been building for the last 10 years. AI only accelerates this mission,” said Ben Eachus, CEO and co-founder of Flowspace.


Flowspace launched FlowspaceAI in 2024 to embed intelligence directly into the workflows where fulfillment happens. Its agents identify at-risk orders, determine the best shipping carrier to use based on price and performance, flag aging inventory, detect service-level risks and increasingly resolve operational issues without human intervention.


One agent addresses shipping label-generation failures, which can stop orders on the warehouse floor and delay shipments. Using automated diagnostics, predictive detection and generative reasoning, the agent identifies the cause of a failure and resolves eligible issues automatically. Since deployment, the agent has reduced customer support tickets by 25 **%** .


“Brands should not have to expand their team every time order volume reaches a new level,” said Jason Harbert, co-founder and chief technology officer of Flowspace. “They need technology and a fulfillment partner capable of absorbing the complexity of growth. FlowspaceAI monitors every metric, for every customer, across our network, noticing deviations and resolving issues immediately.”


Flowspace estimates that its fulfillment network and optimization technology have saved brands more than **$55 million in logistics expenses** , with brands realizing up to **20% in average per-shipment savings** .


The company has also extended its platform through Model Context Protocol, or MCP, allowing brands to connect Flowspace capabilities with their own AI systems and build custom workflows using fulfillment and inventory data.


**About Flowspace**


Flowspace is a modern fulfillment provider that combines powerful technology with expert fulfillment operations to help brands scale without adding operational complexity. Its software and distributed fulfillment network provide a single system of record for managing inventory and fulfillment across e-commerce, retail and wholesale channels.


FlowspaceAI, the company’s suite of autonomous operations agents, monitors fulfillment activity, identifies risks and resolves routine issues so brands can grow order volume without proportionally expanding their internal operations teams. Learn more at[flow.space](https://flow.space/) .
